problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained convex minimization on ℝᵈ with globally L-Lipschitz gradient and a global minimizer xstar satisfying ‖x0−xstar‖≤R.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: Each query x returns ∇f(x). Every history and seed must return the exact gradient; no function values or noisy observations are supplied.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Euclidean space ℝᵈ. All parameters d,L,x0,R,ε are public. Require L,R,ε>0, 262144ε≤LR², and d≥65536(⌊√(LR²/ε)/512⌋+1)⁵.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The output is a point in ℝᵈ; its objective gap relative to an attained global minimum is integrable and has integral at most ε.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: Expected objective gap E[f(output)−f(xstar)]≤ε under the execution probability law, allowing randomized algorithms.

setup_category.label: classical
setup_category.reason: Standard smooth convex exact-gradient optimization with expected objective accuracy; the small-accuracy and large-dimension restrictions specify a lower-bound benchmark regime.

descriptionHtml:
Expected Smooth Convex Minimization

We consider minimizing a differentiable convex function f:Rd→R with L-Lipschitz gradient, where d is a nonnegative integer and L>0. A given point x0∈Rd lies within Euclidean distance R>0 of a global minimizer x⋆. The oracle returns ∇f(x) at x. For a tolerance ε>0, the goal is a random output x¯∈Rd with integrable objective gap and EP[f(x¯)−f(x⋆)]≤ε, where P is the law of the algorithm’s randomness. The parameters satisfy the accuracy and dimension restrictions specified below.

The optimization problem is minx∈Rdf(x). Throughout, ∥⋅∥ denotes the Euclidean norm. The algorithm receives d, L, x0, R, and ε.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Parameter regime). The parameters satisfy d∈Z≥0 and L,R,ε>0, with 262144ε≤LR2,65536(⌊LR2/ε512⌋+1)5≤d.

Assumption 2 (Convexity and smoothness). The function f is differentiable everywhere on Rd. For every x,y∈Rd and t∈[0,1], f((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)f(x)+tf(y),∥∇f(x)−∇f(y)∥≤L∥x−y∥.

Assumption 3 (Initial distance). There exists x⋆∈Rd such that f(x⋆)≤f(x)for every x∈Rd,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R.

Queries may be made at any point of Rd. After the allotted oracle calls, the output x¯ must have an integrable objective gap under P and satisfy EP[f(x¯)−f(x⋆)]≤ε.

source:
import LongTails.Setups.SmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.PiL2
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Sqrt

namespace LongTails.Setups.SmoothAndConvexExpected

open OracleTemplate MeasureTheory

structure Params where
  d : ℕ
  L : ℝ
  x0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  R : ℝ
  ε : ℝ

noncomputable abbrev Params.toSmoothAndConvex (q : Params) : SmoothAndConvex.Params :=
  { E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q.d), L := q.L, x0 := q.x0, R := q.R, ε := q.ε }

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d) → ℝ
  Query p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d)
  Reply p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d)
  Output p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d)
  publicInput := id
  valid q := 0 < q.L ∧ 0 < q.R ∧ 0 < q.ε ∧ 262144 * q.ε ≤ q.L * q.R ^ 2 ∧
    65536 * (⌊Real.sqrt (q.L * q.R ^ 2 / q.ε) / 512⌋₊ + 1) ^ 5 ≤ q.d
  admissible q := SmoothAndConvex.spec.admissible q.toSmoothAndConvex
  successful q f output P :=
    ∃ xstar, IsMinOn f Set.univ xstar ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => f (output ω) - f xstar) (P : Measure _) ∧
      (∫ ω, f (output ω) - f xstar ∂(P : Measure _)) ≤ q.ε

end LongTails.Setups.SmoothAndConvexExpected
